steps.say: Severe checkpoint toxicity of grade 3 or higher is demanding instant drug stoppage. Permanent discontinuation of the inhibitor is starting the rescue. Pulsed methylprednisolone 1 g daily for 3 days is flooding the inflammation. Early abatacept with pooled immunoglobulin or infliximab is reinforcing the pulse. Stopping drugs with pulsing steroids and rescue is saving lives.
